[![Print](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/media/system/images/printButton.png)](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/index.php/news/local-news/77522-university-of-michigan-consumer-sentiment-final-results-for-april-2026-collapses-under-president-trump-to-an-all-time-low-as-year-ahead-inflation-expectations-surged?tmpl=component&print=1 "Print article < University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Final Results for April 2026 Collapses Under President Trump To An All Time Low as Year-ahead Inflation Expectations Surged >") - [![Email](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/media/system/images/emailButton.png)](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/index.php/component/mailto/?tmpl=component&template=rt_spectral&link=a02a42ebce118c766ef3fe92697f17386d889e7c "Email this link to a friend") Details Last Updated: Friday, 24 April 2026 10:03 Published: Friday, 24 April 2026 10:03 April 24, 2026 – On Friday, the University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Final Results for April 2026 was released. Note: April 2024 Consumer Sentiment under President Biden was 77.2 The following is from Surveys of Consumers Director Joanne Hsu: **![Donald trump 2025](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/images/2025/Donald-trump-2025.JPG)** Consumer sentiment ticked down 3.5 index points this month, now comparable to the trough seen in June 2022. Decreases in sentiment were seen across political party, income, age, and education. Expected business conditions declined for both short and long time horizons, nearly matching year-ago readings when the reciprocal tariff regime was implemented. After the two-week cease-fire was announced and gas prices softened a touch, sentiment recovered a modest portion of its early-month losses. The Iran conflict appears to influence consumer views primarily through shocks to gasoline and potentially other prices. In contrast, military and diplomatic developments that do not lift supply constraints or lower energy prices are unlikely to buoy consumers. Year-ahead inflation expectations surged from 3.8% in March to 4.7% this month, the largest one-month increase since April 2025. The current reading exceeds those seen in 2024 and remains well above the 2.3-3.0% range seen in the two years pre-pandemic. After hovering between 3.2 and 3.3% for the previous four months, long-run inflation expectations climbed to 3.5% in April, the highest reading since October 2025. In 2024, values ranged between 2.8% and 3.2%, while in 2019 and 2020, they were consistently below 2.8%. ![cs424.1](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/images/2026/april/cs424.1.JPG) ![cs424.2](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/images/2026/april/cs424.2.JPG) Source: University of Michigan [![Happy Burger 300 lg](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/images/2025/Happy-Burger-300-lg.gif)](https://happyburgerdiner.com/ "‘Click’ here to visit Happy Burger Diner in Mariposa… Now Offering Patio Dining – “We have FREE Wi-Fi, we’re Eco-Friendly & have the Largest Menu in the Sierra”") ## More News Articles - [Mariposa County High School Spanish III Class Cook Colombian Cuisine at Pacifico Restaurant in San Francisco - 2026-04-26](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/index.php/news/local-news/77571-mariposa-county-high-school-spanish-iii-class-cook-colombian-cuisine-at-pacifico-restaurant-in-san-francisco) - [Fresno Police Detectives Seek Public’s Help IDing Suspects Wanted for Armed Robbery - 2026-04-26](https://goldrushcam.com/sierrasuntimes/index.php/news/local-news/77568-fresno-police-detectives-seek-public-s-help-iding-suspects-wanted-for-armed-robbery) - [Curious About AI and How it Impacts Us?
